title: 1-Bounded Entropy for $C^*$-Algebras
summary: Towards a question of Voiculescu, two notions of $1$-bounded entropy, $h$ and $h^\text{top}$, are defined for $C^*$-algebras. The quantity $h$ involves the tracial completion with respect to all traces while the quantity $h^\text{top}$ depends on operator norm microstates. It is demonstrated that $h^\text{top}(\mathscr{A})$ does not exceed $h(\mathscr{A})$ for all $C^*$-algebras $\mathscr{A}$. Moreover, a variational principle enabling the computation of $h$ is introduced.
